title_en: Apartment 2+1 for sale, near Bardhyl Street, Tirana (ID 4119464)
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale on the edge of Bardhyl street (small ring road). Apartment for sale 2+1 buz Bardhyl str. It is located on the 3rd floor of a 4-story building (east and south-west orientation). The apartment has been completely restored from scratch, plastering, electrical, multi-layer plumbing, flush toilet, new doors, thermal double-glazed plastic windows, parquet, painting skates, etc. The area is 70 meters, but the certificate says 63 m². Selling price 148,000 euros.
